turn_prompts: Read the host-projected candidate snapshot and validation receipt. Do not write files; submit only typed findings.

For a repairable issue use code solution_integrity_defect, producing_stage solution_integrity_critic, target_writer authoring_repair, and bind evidence_digest and diagnostic_digest to the validation receipt digest plus candidate_digest to the candidate snapshot digest. If the validation receipt is rejected, emit solution_integrity_defect from its bounded diagnostics; do not return an empty finding.

Completion requires exactly one harbor_submit_output tool call, never a prose final answer. Submit every declared output with {"verdict":"pass","artifacts":[{"name":"DECLARED_OUTPUT_NAME","content":"STRUCTURED_ARTIFACT"}]}; use the exact declared name and one entry for each declared output.
